short.en: Displays Windows Server roles and features per computer, collected by GLPI Agent.

long.en:
Adds a **Windows Server Roles** tab on each Computer item in GLPI, listing the Windows roles and features installed on Windows Server hosts.
**How it works**
A small Perl module ships alongside the plugin and is deployed to the GLPI Agent on each Windows Server. During every standard inventory cycle the module runs `Get-WindowsFeature` and emits each installed role as a regular `SOFTWARES` entry, with the name prefixed `[WinServerRole]` and a structured payload (NAME, DisplayName, Installed flag, Sub-features) pipe-encoded in the COMMENTS field. No custom inventory section, no custom HTTP endpoint, no shared secrets — everything travels over the GLPI Agent's existing authenticated inventory channel.
The plugin's Computer tab then queries `glpi_softwares` joined to `glpi_items_softwareversions` for entries with the `[WinServerRole]` prefix and renders them as a table with Name, Display Name, Installed, Sub-features and Last update columns.
**Features**
- Dedicated **Windows Server Roles** tab on Computer items - Tab counter badge shows the number of installed roles per computer - Search options for filtering computers by role name or last-update date - Compatible with GLPI 11 (uses standard inventory pipeline; no `pre_inventory` hook required) - No custom authentication endpoint — relies entirely on the GLPI Agent's existing Basic Auth / OAuth flow - Marketplace-clean: no `Firewall::STRATEGY_NO_CHECK`, no plaintext shared-secret tokens, no custom auth headers
**Requirements**
- GLPI 11.0.6 or later - GLPI Agent on each Windows Server (the WinServerRoles.pm module is included in the release ZIP under `agent/GLPI/Agent/Task/Inventory/Win32/`) - Windows Server 2012 R2 or later (the agent module uses the `ServerManager` PowerShell module)
